Subject: Mutual Action Plan — initial draft, timeboxes & owner confirm

Alex — thanks again for a constructive discovery call this morning. Attached is the first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that Ben and I sketched from today’s notes (Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx). Quick recap and asks below: 

Summary of key business goals (from call)
- Proof-of-concept to validate inference latency and cost at 95th percentile under Clearsight’s mixed-traffic profile
- Pilot with 2 endpoints (customer-facing search + agent assistant)
- Training and runbook for internal SREs

Proposed milestone structure (initial draft)
1) Technical validation (Ben) — infra benchmark + sample dataset ingestion — target: 2 weeks after kickoff
2) Security review (Lauren) — SSO & data flow diagram review — target: 3 weeks
3) Procurement/Commercial (Hannah) — finalize PO and billing terms — target: 4–6 weeks
4) Pilot run & success criteria (Ben/Alex) — 2–4 week pilot window

Two timeline options (pick one)
- Option A (Aggressive): Kickoff this week -> pilot start in 6 weeks -> close in 8–10 weeks
- Option B (Phased): Kickoff next week -> staggered technical & security milestones -> pilot in 10–12 weeks

Dependencies we noted
- Procurement PO or credit line (Clearsight finance)
- Test dataset access + basic S3 connectivity
- Completion of security questionnaire items around retention/audit logs

Ask — please: 
1) Confirm the stakeholders who should be on the MAP (owner + backup)
2) Pick timeline option A or B or suggest target close date
3) Confirm any other dependencies we missed (procurement contact, legal reviewer, SRE lead)

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP matrix), Discovery_Notes_20261017.pdf

Thanks — Ben and I are available for a 30‑minute kickoff to walk the MAP if that helps.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
